description:
6-8 years experience in Sharepoint platform( development and administration). 
 Sharepoint 2013 development experience is a mandate. 
 Good knowledge of jQuery, java script, HTML5.Hands on experience in Sharepoint 2013 development - javascript client object model, content search webparts, jQuery components, applications creens, server object model, workflows (SharePoint designer/Visual Studio), timer jobs, app model. 
 Any experience in Lotus Notes to SharePoint migration is an added advantage. 
 Knowledge of 3rd party tools like Nintex workflows, AvePoint products like DocAve is an added advantage. 
 Knowledge of SQL 2008 and above is an added advantage.   
 The associate is required to support the project with the migration of “non-template based” applications in Notes to Sharepoint. 

 Functional requirements  
 Associate is responsible for: Driving the analysis and implementation of application changes. Active participation in all the onsite driven activities like requirement gathering, meetings with business users, interaction with SP admin team for deployment of SP packagesActing as middle man between Business users at onsite and applications development team at offshoreMigrating complex applications to Sharepoint if needed together with development Team.Must be fluent in English  


 Job Status: Full Time 
 
 Eligibility: EAD GC or GC or US Citizen 
 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions(dot)com 

 
 Contact: 703 349 1214
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
